title: lantana trifolia f. congolensis
intro: Lantana trifolia f. congolensis, commonly known as Congolese lantana, is a plant species within the Lantana genus. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Congolese lantana include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and pain management. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
